svg.title: Two values, two read paths
svg.desc: A benchmark question: 'How many titles are currently on my to-watch list?' The store holds two explicit conclusions: 20 titles, said on 20 May at 10:21, and 25 titles, said on 22 May at 03:29. Left, the representation hands both dated lines to the answering model, which answers: 'The most recent record… is from May 22, 2023, which states the list consists of 25 titles.' Correct. Right, the dialectic's prompt has two rules for this case: ask the user which statement is correct, and the more recent statement supersedes. Its reply lists both values and ends 'Which of these numbers is correct?'. The answering model, given that reply, answers that it is not possible to determine the number. Five of the dialectic path's nine wrong answers were of this kind. Honcho 3.5.0 later made the dialectic answer in a single turn.
svg.text: Two values, two read paths
A question from the experiment. The store holds both values with their times; the two read paths hand them over in
different shapes.
THE STORE
“How many titles are currently on my to-watch list?”
user has a to-watch list consisting of 20 titles.
user has a to-watch list consisting of 25 titles.
REPRESENTATION
no model call
DIALECTIC
an agent
What is handed over
Both lines, each with its time, go to the answering model as
they are.
Two sections of its prompt fit this case:
“Ask the user which statement is correct”
“The MORE RECENT statement supersedes”
Its reply, handed over
“… I do not have information confirming whether your list was
updated or if one of these figures was recorded in error. Which
of these numbers is correct?”
The answering model, given what each path handed over:
Correct
“The most recent record… is from May 22, 2023, which states
the list consists of 25 titles.”
Wrong
“It is not possible to determine the exact number of titles
currently on your to-watch list. The history contains conflicting
information (20 titles on May 20 vs. 25 titles on May 22)…”
Five of the dialectic path's nine wrong answers were of this kind. Honcho 3.5.0 (released 30 October 2026, after the experiment) made the
dialectic answer in a single turn, without a question at the end.
From the experiment, question 4d6b87c8, Honcho 3.3.0
